title: Structural Hierarchy — Foundation Layer (BaseEngine + Service Contracts)
description: Create the missing BaseEngine contract and Service layer interfaces. This is the foundation that all subsequent ARCH milestones depend on. Establishes IEngine interface, BaseEngine abstract class, and service contracts (IMaterialService, IMachineService, IToolService, IPhysicsService, IConfigService) that mediate between engines and registries. Also ensures thermal/stability constants exist in canonical constants.ts before downstream rewiring.

sessions.title: IEngine Contract + BaseEngine Abstract Class + Service Layer
sessions.intent: Every engine has a contract to implement. New engines get type errors if they skip required methods. Existing engines continue to work unchanged (opt-in adoption). Service layer provides the mediation seam for data access.

units.title: Create IEngine interface and BaseEngine abstract class
units.description: Define src/engines/IEngine.ts with: name, version, execute(), validate(), getCapabilities(). Create src/engines/BaseEngine.ts abstract class implementing IEngine with default validate() (Zod) and logging. Pattern: mirror BaseRegistry from src/registries/base.ts. Must be opt-in — existing engines don't break.
units.four_loop: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP
exit_criteria: BaseEngine.ts extends IEngine with default implementations
git diff shows zero changes to existing engine files (opt-in verified)

units.title: Create service layer interfaces (5 contracts) with unit-type enforcement
units.description: Create src/services/interfaces/ directory with: IMaterialService.ts, IMachineService.ts, IToolService.ts, IPhysicsConstantsService.ts, IConfigService.ts. Each interface defines query methods that engines will call instead of importing registries directly. IPhysicsConstantsService MUST propagate unit metadata (e.g., getConstant returns {value, unit, source} not bare number) to preserve dimensional consistency.
units.four_loop: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP
exit_criteria: Each interface has 3+ methods matching current registry usage patterns
IPhysicsConstantsService methods return {value, unit, source} tuples
Interfaces use types from src/types.ts not inline definitions

abort_criteria: interface methods don't match actual registry API

units.title: Implement concrete services + ensure canonical constants coverage
units.description: Create src/services/MaterialService.ts implementing IMaterialService by delegating to MaterialRegistry singleton. Same for MachineService.ts → MachineRegistry, ToolService.ts → ToolRegistry, PhysicsConstantsService.ts → src/physics/constants.ts, ConfigService.ts → new src/data/shop-config.json. Export all from src/services/index.ts. CRITICAL: Before implementing PhysicsConstantsService, verify that CHIP_HEAT_FRACTION, TOOL_HEAT_FRACTION, STEEL_THERMAL_EXPANSION exist in constants.ts. If missing, ADD them with cited sources before wrapping.
units.four_loop: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP
exit_criteria: Unit tests for each service (5 test files)
PhysicsConstantsService exposes all thermal/stability constants with units
constants.ts contains CHIP_HEAT_FRACTION, TOOL_HEAT_FRACTION, STEEL_THERMAL_EXPANSION (added if missing)

abort_criteria: physics constants added without cited source
